articles.summary: Geodis is a global 3PL providing warehousing and fulfillment. Connect its SFTP file exchange to sync inventory and inbound shipments (receipts and ASNs).
articles.title: Geodis

articles.summary: TLogistics is a European third-party logistics provider running a JDA/Blue Yonder warehouse system. Connect it to sync inventory, products, orders and inbound shipments.
articles.title: TLogistics

articles.summary: Return Helper is a cross-border returns platform that issues return labels, receives returned parcels at its warehouses, and handles the returned stock (restock, resend, recall or dispose). Connect it to sync returns and returned inventory.
articles.title: Return Helper

articles.summary: Rithum (formerly CommerceHub) connects retail channels like The Home Depot to their suppliers over EDI. Connect it to sync orders, send shipments with tracking, and send inventory levels.
articles.title: Rithum - Home Depot

articles.summary: SnapFulfil is a cloud-based warehouse management system (WMS). Connect it to sync inventory, products, orders, shipments, and warehouse data.
articles.title: Snapfulfil

articles.summary: Delmar Connect is the API platform for Delmar, a third-party logistics and warehousing provider. Connect it to submit warehouse shipping orders and inbound stock transfers.
articles.title: Delmar

articles.summary: NPFulfilment (National Products Fulfilment) is an Australia-based third-party logistics and warehouse provider. Connect it to sync inventory and order status, and to send orders, inbound shipments, and new products to the warehouse.
articles.title: NPFulfilment
